title: LoRA Weight Sweep
question: Under fixed generation and Hires.fix settings, how does the tested LoRA weight affect final image style strength, aesthetic quality, coordination, and artifact level?

dimensions.style_strength: How clearly the tested LoRA target visual features appear.
dimensions.aesthetic_quality: The evaluator's personal judgment of overall visual appeal and completeness.
dimensions.coordination: How naturally the tested LoRA works with the checkpoint, fixed LoRAs, and prompt.
dimensions.artifact_level: Visible artifacts or structural problems; higher means worse.

notes: All ratings refer to final Hires.fix outputs rather than base-resolution images.
The full prompt and negative prompt remain in README.md because the public prompt record includes content the author may wish to keep under manual review.
This experiment has three seeds and one evaluator; it is exploratory rather than strong statistical evidence.
